reason: A DeepSeek Harness interface plugin that adds a continuous reasoning-effort slider, persists the selected level in the model menu, and provisions compatible effort mappings for custom models.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 模型菜单添加可拖动的推理强度滑块，并将选定等级应用到支持的模型请求配置中。
summaries.en: Adds a draggable reasoning-effort slider to the DeepSeek Harness model menu and applies the selected level to compatible model request settings.

capabilities: Adds an Effort slider panel to the model menu
Writes the selected reasoningEffort through the local DSH session interface
Injects reasoning metadata and wire-level effort mappings for supported custom models
Reads and updates the plugin settings section through the DSH settings service
